h3. Root Cause
*Classification: Infra Issue — Cluster-wide Zookeeper quorum loss on nested AHV cluster during Cassandra ring scrambling*

The test's Setup intentionally scrambles the Cassandra ring (step 42) by issuing token reassignments via set_token(). Approximately 3m44s after ring scrambling began, the nested AHV cluster (6 CVMs in phx1 lab) experienced a cluster-wide ZK connectivity failure.

*Evidence:*
* ZK session establishment timed out simultaneously across all 6 CVMs — not a single-node or transient issue
* Narsil crashed on every CVM with 'zk: connection closed' at 02:23:41
* Multiple services (hera, pithos, guru_aux, vip_monitor, prism) all lost ZK connectivity within the same 2-minute window
* OOM kill on CVM .245 indicates memory exhaustion on the nested cluster hosts
* Stargate fail-fast on 5/6 CVMs confirms cluster instability extends beyond ZK alone

*Inferred mechanism:* The Cassandra ring scrambling operation generates high metadata load. On a resource-constrained nested AHV cluster, this can starve ZK heartbeat threads of CPU/memory, causing ZK session timeouts to exceed the configured limits (12–20s). With ZK quorum lost, all dependent services fail in cascade. This is consistent with OOM evidence on .245 suggesting the nested cluster VMs were under memory pressure.

*Test code observation:* cassandra_ring_changer.py:wait_for_cassandra_status() calls _get_cassandra_status_from_zeus() which runs zeus_config_printer as a subprocess. If the subprocess QFATALs due to ZK unavailability, the resulting ValueError is not caught and propagates as a test Setup failure. This is a secondary concern (test robustness) but the primary failure is infrastructure.
